pose_en: She stands upright in the middle of a small round fitness MINI-TRAMPOLINE (a round black jumping mat about one metre wide on short legs, clearly drawn, about 25 cm high), seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view from her right side. Both feet are on the jumping mat at hip width, arms relaxed by her sides. The arrow is a curved arrow at her RIGHT knee pointing UP, showing the right knee being lifted to march.
eind_en: END position: same view, still standing on the mini-trampoline. Her RIGHT knee is lifted to hip height (thigh horizontal, shin vertical), her left foot is on the jumping mat and her LEFT arm swings forward, the right arm back, like brisk marching. Trunk upright.
extra_avatar: The mini-trampoline (round jumping mat on short legs) must be clearly visible under her feet in both figures. TOP: both feet on the mat. BOTTOM: right thigh horizontal, opposite arm forward.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right). She stands on her RIGHT leg only, knee straight. Her LEFT knee is bent about 90 degrees so the left foot is lifted BEHIND her, the left shin roughly horizontal, the foot well off the floor. Her hands rest on her hips and her trunk is upright. The arrow is a curved arrow at the front of the right knee pointing FORWARD and DOWN, showing the standing knee bending into a small one-leg knee bend.
eind_en: END position: same side view. She still stands on the RIGHT leg only, the right knee now clearly bent about 45 degrees with the knee above the toes, hips pushed slightly back, trunk leaning slightly forward with a straight back. The left foot is still lifted behind her with the knee bent, hands still on the hips.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from her right side. In BOTH figures only the right foot touches the floor and the left foot is held up behind her. TOP: right leg straight. BOTTOM: right knee clearly bent (quarter knee bend), knee over the toes, pelvis level.

naam: Bovenrug rekken – handen gevouwen naar voren
pose_en: She stands upright, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right). Her fingers are interlaced, hands held close in front of her chest, elbows bent and pointing down-out, head upright. The arrow is a straight arrow starting at her clasped hands pointing FORWARD (toward the viewer's right), showing the arms being pushed straight forward.
eind_en: END position: same side view. Her arms are fully straight forward at shoulder height with the fingers still interlaced, palms turned toward the front; her upper back is clearly ROUNDED (hunched), the shoulders pulled forward and her chin lowered toward her chest. Feet unchanged.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from her right side. Make the difference obvious: TOP upright with hands at the chest; BOTTOM arms straight forward, upper back clearly rounded like a cat, chin down.

naam: Knieschijf zijwaarts bewegen – zelf met je vingers
pose_en: CLOSE-UP framing: show only her right leg from mid-thigh to the ankle and both her hands, seen from ABOVE and slightly from the front, as she sits on a chair with the RIGHT leg straight and relaxed, the right heel resting on a second chair in front of her. The thumbs of both hands rest on the INNER edge of the right kneecap and the index and middle fingertips on the OUTER edge, so the kneecap sits between her fingers. The arrow is a short, thick straight arrow on the kneecap pointing SIDEWAYS toward the OUTSIDE of the knee, showing the kneecap being slid outward.
eind_en: END position: the same close-up view from above. The thumbs have pushed the kneecap clearly sideways toward the OUTSIDE of the knee (exaggerate: about 2 cm off-centre), the fingertips have moved with it; the leg stays straight and relaxed with the heel on the second chair.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP of only the straight right knee and both hands, seen from above. TOP: kneecap centred between the thumbs and fingers. BOTTOM: kneecap visibly shifted toward the outside of the knee by the thumbs - exaggerate the shift so the difference is obvious.

naam: Ellebogen naar achteren trekken – zittend zonder gewicht
pose_en: She sits upright on a plain chair, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right). Both arms are stretched straight forward at shoulder height, palms facing each other, hands empty. Feet flat on the floor. The arrow is a curved arrow starting at her right hand pointing BACKWARD (toward the viewer's left) along her side, showing the elbows being pulled back.
eind_en: END position: same side view on the same chair. Both elbows are bent and pulled far BACKWARD close along her body, the elbows behind her back, the empty hands next to her lower ribs; her shoulder blades are squeezed together and her chest is lifted. Trunk upright, feet flat.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from her right side, no weights and no band - the hands are empty. TOP: arms straight forward. BOTTOM: elbows clearly behind the back, chest proud.

pose_en: She WALKS, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side, she faces and walks toward the viewer's RIGHT. Mid-stride: her right foot is forward with the heel touching the floor, the left foot behind on its toes, the arms swinging naturally (left arm forward). Draw ONE long arrow that starts in front of her chest, goes forward to the right and then curves back in a U-turn (a half circle) pointing to the LEFT, showing that she walks forward and then turns around.
eind_en: END position: she has turned around completely and now stands STILL, facing the viewer's LEFT (the opposite direction to the top figure), feet together at hip width, arms relaxed by her sides, balanced and upright. Both figures seen from the side.
extra_avatar: TOP figure walking to the viewer's RIGHT mid-stride. BOTTOM figure standing still facing the viewer's LEFT, feet side by side - the change of facing direction must be obvious.

pose_en: She WALKS briskly, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side, walking toward the viewer's RIGHT. Moment one: her RIGHT heel has just landed in front of her with the knee almost straight, the LEFT foot is behind her pushing off from the toes; her LEFT arm swings forward and the right arm back, elbows slightly bent. Upright posture, eyes forward. The arrow is a long straight arrow in front of her at hip height pointing FORWARD (to the viewer's right), showing the walking direction.
eind_en: END position (next step): same side view, walking to the viewer's right. Now her LEFT heel has just landed in front of her and the RIGHT foot is behind her on its toes; her RIGHT arm swings forward and the left arm back. Upright posture.
extra_avatar: Both figures walk to the viewer's RIGHT, seen exactly from the side. TOP: right foot in front, left arm forward. BOTTOM: left foot in front, right arm forward. Ordinary walking, not running: one foot always on the ground.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the FRONT, facing the viewer. Her feet are very wide apart (about twice shoulder width), toes pointing forward, both feet flat on the floor, both knees straight, hands on her hips. The arrow is a curved arrow from her pelvis going sideways and DOWN toward HER RIGHT (the viewer's left), showing her hips shifting over the right leg as the right knee bends.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front. Her weight has shifted to HER RIGHT (the viewer's left): the right knee is clearly bent over the right foot, the LEFT leg is completely straight with the inner thigh stretched, both feet still flat on the floor at the same place, toes forward, trunk upright, hands on hips.
extra_avatar: Seen from the front. The feet do not move between TOP and BOTTOM. BOTTOM: deep bend in her right knee (viewer's left), left leg straight, both soles flat on the floor.

naam: Hiel in de grond drukken – ruglig (zonder bewegen)
pose_en: CLOSE-UP framing: show her from the hips to the feet (plus the hands beside the hips), seen exactly from the side, head toward the left out of frame. She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat. Her LEFT knee is bent with the left foot flat on the mat. Her RIGHT leg is only slightly bent (knee about 30 degrees), the right foot resting ONLY on the heel on the mat, toes pointing up. Nothing moves. Draw ONE short straight arrow at the right heel pointing DOWN into the mat and slightly toward her buttocks, showing the heel pressing into the floor.
eind_en: She holds this position: lying on her back, left knee bent with the foot flat, right knee slightly bent with only the right heel on the mat; the right heel presses firmly down into the mat and the muscles at the back of the right thigh are visibly tensed. Nothing moves.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP seen exactly from the side: only the hips, legs and feet on the mat are shown. The right heel is pressed into the mat and the back of the right thigh is visibly firm; the knee angle does not change.

naam: Armen kruisen boven je hoofd en voor je borst
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the FRONT, facing the viewer, feet at hip width. Both arms are stretched straight out to the SIDES at shoulder height, palms down, making a T-shape. Draw ONE curved arrow from her right hand going UP in an arc over her head, showing the straight arms swinging up to cross above the head.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front. Both straight arms are raised high above her head and CROSSED at the wrists, forming an X above the head. Trunk upright, feet unchanged.
extra_avatar: Seen from the front. TOP: arms straight out to the sides (T). BOTTOM: arms straight up, crossed at the wrists above the head (X).

naam: Brug op één been – voet op een step
pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side, head to the viewer's left. A low aerobic STEP (a flat rectangular platform about 20 cm high) stands at her feet. Her RIGHT heel rests on top of the step with the right knee bent about 90 degrees; her LEFT leg is straight and lifted toward the ceiling at about 45 degrees. Arms flat beside her body, buttocks on the mat. The arrow is a curved arrow under her pelvis pointing UP, showing the hips being lifted.
eind_en: END position: same side view. Her pelvis is lifted high so her shoulders, hips and right knee form a straight line; only the shoulders and the right heel (on the step) carry her weight. The left leg is still straight and raised in line with the thigh. Arms flat on the mat.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side, the step clearly visible under the right heel. TOP: buttocks on the mat. BOTTOM: hips high in a straight line, left leg still lifted, pelvis level.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view from her right side, so both legs are clearly visible. Her LEFT foot is crossed in FRONT of her right foot (the left foot placed on the outer side of the right foot), both knees straight but soft. Her hands rest on the front of her thighs. The arrow is a curved arrow starting at her upper back going FORWARD and DOWN, showing the trunk bending forward from the hips.
eind_en: END position: same three-quarter view, feet still crossed (left in front). She bends forward from the hips with a long back, trunk at about 60 degrees, her hands slid down along the front of her legs to about knee height; knees still almost straight.
extra_avatar: The crossed feet (left foot in front of the right) must be clearly visible in BOTH figures. BOTTOM: trunk bent well forward from the hips, hands near the knees.

naam: Achterkant bovenarm rekken – hand achter je hoofd
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up, seen in a THREE-QUARTER BACK view from her right side, so her upper back and the right arm are clearly visible. Her RIGHT arm is raised with the elbow bent and pointing up to the ceiling, the right hand hanging behind her head at the base of the neck. Her LEFT hand holds the right elbow from above. The arrow is a short curved arrow at the right elbow pointing BACKWARD and DOWN, showing the left hand pushing the elbow behind her head.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view. The left hand has pushed the right elbow further back behind her head, the right elbow still pointing up, and the right hand has slid lower down between her shoulder blades. Head upright.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips up, three-quarter view from behind on her right side. TOP: right hand behind the neck. BOTTOM: right hand clearly lower between the shoulder blades, elbow pushed back by the left hand.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the FRONT, facing the viewer. Her feet are wide apart (about one and a half times shoulder width) and both feet are clearly turned OUT about 45 degrees, toes pointing diagonally outward. Knees straight, hands on her hips, trunk upright. The arrow is a straight arrow at her pelvis pointing straight DOWN, showing her sinking straight down.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front. She has sunk straight down with both knees bent about 90 degrees, the knees pointing OUTWARD over the turned-out toes; the trunk stays vertical (no forward lean), hands on hips, feet unchanged.
extra_avatar: Seen from the front, feet clearly turned out in both figures. BOTTOM: thighs almost horizontal, knees pushed out over the toes, trunk perfectly upright.

pose_en: She sits on a plain chair, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view from her right side, feet flat and apart. Her trunk is bent far FORWARD over her thighs. Her RIGHT hand grips the right FRONT leg of the chair low down, the right arm almost straight; her LEFT hand rests on the outside of the right elbow. The arrow is a short straight arrow at the right elbow pointing DOWN toward the floor, showing the left hand pushing the elbow down.
eind_en: END position: same view. The left hand has pushed the right elbow further DOWN toward the floor; the right shoulder has dropped lower and the right side of her upper back is more rounded. The right hand still grips the chair leg, buttocks stay on the seat.
extra_avatar: The chair leg in her right hand and the left hand on the right elbow must be clearly visible. BOTTOM: right shoulder clearly lower, elbow nearer the floor.

pose_en: She sits upright on the edge of a sturdy low treatment bench (instead of a chair), seen from the FRONT, facing the viewer, feet flat on the floor. Both hands are flat on the bench right beside her hips, fingers forward, elbows slightly bent. The arrow is a straight arrow under her buttocks pointing UP, showing the body being pushed up by the arms.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front. Both arms are now fully straight and her buttocks are lifted clearly off the bench (about 5 cm, exaggerate the gap), the body hanging between the straight arms, shoulders pushed down, feet still lightly on the floor.
extra_avatar: Seen from the front, the gap between the buttocks and the bench must be clearly visible in the BOTTOM figure; TOP figure sits with bent elbows.

naam: Traplopen met leuning – trede voor trede
pose_en: Seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side, she faces the viewer's RIGHT, at the bottom of a short indoor staircase (three or four steps going up to the viewer's right) with a handrail along the right side of the stairs. Her RIGHT hand holds the handrail. Her RIGHT foot is already placed on the FIRST step, the left foot still on the floor. The arrow is a curved arrow from her left foot going UP and FORWARD onto the first step next to the right foot, showing the second leg joining on the same step.
eind_en: END position: same side view. Both feet now stand side by side on the FIRST step, her right hand has slid a little further up the handrail, trunk upright.
extra_avatar: The staircase and handrail must be clearly visible. TOP: right foot on the first step, left foot on the floor. BOTTOM: both feet together on the same first step (step-to pattern, not step-over).

naam: Voorkant heup rekken – been over de bedrand
pose_en: She lies on her BACK on a bed close to its edge, seen from the side of the bed: we look at her RIGHT side, her head on a pillow to the viewer's left. Both legs lie straight on the mattress. The arrow is a curved arrow from her right knee going over the edge of the bed and DOWN toward the floor, showing the right leg being lowered over the side.
eind_en: END position: same view. Her RIGHT leg now hangs DOWN over the edge of the bed from the hip, the thigh angled down below the mattress, the knee relaxed and slightly bent, the foot near the floor. Her pelvis and the left leg stay flat on the bed.
extra_avatar: The bed edge must be clearly visible. TOP: both legs on the bed. BOTTOM: right thigh hanging down below the level of the mattress, pelvis still on the bed.

naam: Om en om door één neusgat ademen – zittend
pose_en: CLOSE-UP framing: show her head, shoulders and right hand, seen from the FRONT, sitting upright and relaxed with her eyes softly closed. Her RIGHT hand is raised in front of her face: the right THUMB gently presses her RIGHT nostril closed, the ring finger rests lightly beside the left nostril, the index and middle fingers are folded in. Draw ONE short curved arrow just below the LEFT (open) nostril pointing UP into the nose, showing calm breathing in through the open nostril.
eind_en: She holds this position: sitting upright and relaxed, eyes softly closed, the right thumb closing the right nostril and the ring finger beside the left nostril, breathing calmly through the left nostril.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the front: head, shoulders and the right hand only. The thumb on the right nostril and the ring finger beside the left nostril must be clearly visible; five fingers drawn correctly.

pose_en: Frame her from the waist up. She sits upright on a plain chair, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right side is nearest to the viewer, shoulders low and relaxed, hands on her thighs. Her LIPS are clearly PURSED into a small round opening, as if gently blowing out a candle, cheeks relaxed. Draw a short straight arrow starting at her pursed lips and pointing FORWARD, showing the air being blown out slowly.
eind_en: She holds this position: sitting upright and relaxed, lips clearly pursed, slowly blowing the air out through the small opening of her lips, shoulders low.
extra_avatar: Frame her from the waist up, seen from the side. The pursed lips (small round opening, like softly blowing out a candle) must be clearly visible. Calm face, relaxed shoulders. No candle, no objects.

pose_en: She lies FACE DOWN (prone) on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, her forehead resting on her folded hands, both legs straight. An elastic band is looped around her RIGHT ankle and runs along the floor to an anchor low on a table leg BEYOND her feet (on the viewer's left). The arrow is a curved arrow at the right heel going UP and toward her buttocks, showing the right knee bending against the band.
eind_en: END position: same side view, lying face down. The right knee is bent to about a right angle (lower leg vertical), the elastic band stretched tight from the right ankle to the low anchor beyond her feet. Right thigh and hips stay on the mat; left leg straight.
extra_avatar: Lying face down, seen from the side, band anchored low beyond her feet. TOP: both legs straight, band slack. BOTTOM: right lower leg vertical, band stretched taut.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right side is nearest to the viewer, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, hands on her hips, back straight. The arrow is a curved arrow starting at her upper back and going FORWARD and DOWN, showing the straight-backed torso tipping forward from the hips.
eind_en: END position: same side view. Her hips are pushed BACKWARD and her torso, with a long FLAT back, is tipped forward from the hips to about 50 degrees; knees still only slightly bent, head in line with the spine, hands on her hips.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side. TOP: upright. BOTTOM: buttocks pushed back, flat back tipped forward about 50 degrees. The back stays straight (never rounded) and the knees bend only a little - it is a hip hinge, not a squat.

pose_en: She sits upright on a plain chair, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, both feet on the floor, knees bent at a right angle, hands holding the sides of the seat. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right foot going FORWARD and UP, showing the right knee straightening.
eind_en: END position: same side view on the same chair. The right knee is completely STRAIGHT: the right leg points horizontally forward, toes pulled up, the thigh still on the seat. Left foot stays on the floor, back upright.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side. TOP: both feet on the floor. BOTTOM: right leg stretched horizontally forward with a fully straight knee, thigh on the seat.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer. A plain chair stands in front of her with its backrest toward her, and both hands rest lightly on the top of the backrest for balance. Both feet are on the floor, legs straight. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right heel going BACKWARD and UP toward her buttocks, showing the right knee bending.
eind_en: END position: same side view. The right knee is bent past a right angle, the right heel lifted toward her buttock; the right thigh stays vertical beside the left thigh. Torso upright, hands on the chair.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side. TOP: both feet on the floor. BOTTOM: right heel lifted toward the buttock, knee pointing straight down, thighs side by side.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, in front of a low wooden step (about 15 cm high) that is on the floor directly in front of her toes (on the viewer's right). Arms relaxed beside her body. The arrow is a curved arrow starting at her right foot and going UP and FORWARD onto the top of the step, showing the right foot stepping up.
eind_en: END position: same side view. She stands fully upright ON TOP of the step with BOTH feet next to each other, knees and hips straight, arms relaxed.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side, the low step clearly visible in both figures. TOP: standing on the floor in front of the step. BOTTOM: standing upright on top of the step with both feet.
